title: npcs.json — NPC sheets for a MJ Tonnerre campaign (canonical format)
description: Canonical format per references/npc-data-governance.md. Tolerates both containers: bare array [...] OR {"pnj": [...]}. Each sheet distinguishes established_facts (played) and gm_hypotheses (deductions not usable in narration). Two optional private layers (Level 2, audit/06-niveau2-factions.md §4): connaissances_privees (NPC's hidden knowledge, seeded by GM) and notes_privees (agent's inner monologue, appended by the coordinator).

emotions.description: OPTIONAL (skill mygamemaster-emotions). Character's emotional state: 6 emotions 0..1 (joy, confidence, fear, anger, sadness, surprise). `etat` = current intensities; `temperament` = baseline toward which state decays over time; `history` = capped (20) journal of variations (event, actual deltas, reason, session) — every change is EXPLAINABLE, never arbitrary. Managed by scripts/emotions.py (fail-open: missing object = no behavior change).

established_facts.description: What the NPC has SAID or DONE verbatim in play (traceable to a session).

gm_hypotheses.description: GM deductions/assumptions — forbidden in narration without in-play validation.

connaissances_privees.description: OPTIONAL (Level 2). What the NPC KNOWS but has not revealed — hidden knowledge seeded by GM/tools. The agent sees it (private brief section), players do not. Enables lying/hiding coherently.

notes_privees.description: OPTIONAL (Level 2). Agent's inner monologue: reflections, plans, accumulated suspicions turn after turn. Appended by the coordinator (sole writer) via faction_slice.py add-note. Invisible to all others.
